cases.prompt: B2B analytics app. Target segment: self-serve teams of 2 to 20 people on the free trial. Entry intent: see their own product data in a dashboard. Value event: first dashboard with a chart on live data within 7 days; teams that reach it retain 34% at day 60 versus 6% for those that do not. Last 90 days: 4,200 signups, 3,100 finish a 6-step product tour, 1,450 connect a data source, 610 reach the value event. Median time to value is 4.2 days. Support tickets: 180 about SDK install errors, 95 about workspace invite permissions. Improve activation.
sourceAnchors: Activation is an evidenced user outcome, not checklist completion.
Remove or defer steps that do not create value

requiredEvidence: data source connection is the main drop
forbiddenClaims: the change will raise day-60 retention
